jobs.title: Corporate PMO / Business Operations Expert
jobs.description:
Fincons Group is an IT business consulting company that has been designing the digital future of leading companies on international markets for 40 years. Fincons Group built its reputation on foreseeing and interpreting new business models and the rapid evolution of IT systems by building a complete range of services: from research and consulting to design and development, from system integration of leading vendor software solutions right up to application management, supporting clients step by step along their digital transformation journey. Fincons is a multinational with over 2,600 people and several offices worldwide (in Italy, Switzerland, Germany, France, the United Kingdom, Belgium and the USA), but above all a Family Company where the founders play a strategic role with commitment and passion, grounding the company in the same principles of a united and caring family.

We firmly believe in the value of cooperation and in the contribution that every idea and intuition can bring. We believe that everyone’s effort can make a difference. Transforming knowledge into a strategic resource is our company's mission, and we pursue it with the help of our most strategic asset: our people.

## Job Overview

For our Lugano Branch (TI), we are looking for a C orporate PMO / Business Operations Expert to support the DACH General Manager and the regional Business in driving internal operations, governance, and business performance.

Responsibilities and Duties

Executive, Governance & Commercial Support

- Support the DACH General Manager in daily operations and strategic activities
- Prepare dashboards and reports for Top Management and C-level stakeholders
- Support the organization of Steering Committees, Management Meetings and Townhalls
- Maintain and update corporate presentations and institutional materials
- Support market analysis and alignment with Account teams
- Monitor upselling, cross-selling initiatives and pipeline performance
- Manage company references and client portfolio
- Support contract lifecycle (initial review, DocuSign, archiving)
- Collect and consolidate resource and budget inputs from DACH Accounts

Tender & Bid Management

- Support feasibility assessment and planning for tenders and mini-tenders
- Coordinate internal stakeholders in proposal preparation and tender presentation
- Collect and manage required documentation
- Manage client procurement portals (submissions, questionnaires, registrations)

Qualifications & Skills

- Degree in Management Engineering, Business Administration, or related fields
- 2–5 years of experience as PMO or in Business Operations within IT Consulting
- Strong stakeholder management skills (including C-level exposure)
- Excellent organizational and problem-solving skills
- Ability to work independently and manage multiple priorities and stakeholders
- Advanced Excel and PowerPoint skills
- Fluency in English and Italian; German is a plus

If interested, please apply here !

Our personnel search is addressed to candidates of all genders. The data will be processed and stored exclusively for the purposes of this or future selections, in compliance with the Federal Data Protection Law (LPD) and guaranteeing the rights referred to in art. 13 Legislative Decree 196/03 and EU regulation 679/2016 (GDPR).

descriptionByLocale.de:
Die Fincons Group ist ein IT-Business-Beratungsunternehmen, das seit 40 Jahren die digitale Zukunft führender Unternehmen auf internationalen Märkten gestaltet. Die Fincons Group baute ihren Ruf auf der Vorhersage und Interpretation neuer Geschäftsmodelle und der schnellen Entwicklung von IT-Systemen auf, indem sie ein komplettes Dienstleistungsspektrum aufbaute: von Forschung und Beratung über Design und Entwicklung, von der Systemintegration führender Anbieter von Softwarelösungen bis hin zum Anwendungsmanagement und unterstützt Kunden Schritt für Schritt auf ihrem Weg zur digitalen Transformation. Fincons ist ein multinationales Unternehmen mit über 2.600 Mitarbeitern und mehreren Niederlassungen weltweit (in Italien, der Schweiz, Deutschland, Frankreich, dem Vereinigten Königreich, Belgien und den USA), aber vor allem ein Familienunternehmen, in dem die Gründer mit Engagement und Leidenschaft eine strategische Rolle spielen und das Unternehmen auf den gleichen Prinzipien einer vereinten und fürsorglichen Familie gründen. Wir glauben fest an den Wert der Zusammenarbeit und an den Beitrag, den jede Idee und Intuition leisten kann. Wir glauben, dass der Einsatz jedes Einzelnen einen Unterschied machen kann. Wissen in eine strategische Ressource umzuwandeln, ist die Mission unseres Unternehmens, und wir verfolgen sie mit Hilfe unseres strategischsten Kapitals: unseren Mitarbeitern. Rollen und Verantwortlichkeiten: Führungskraft, Governance und kaufmännische Unterstützung – Unterstützung des DACH-General Managers im täglichen Betrieb und bei strategischen Aktivitäten – Erstellung von Dashboards und Berichten für Top-Management- und C-Level-Stakeholder – Unterstützung bei der Organisation von Lenkungsausschüssen, Management-Meetings und Townhalls – Pflege und Aktualisierung von Unternehmenspräsentationen und institutionellen Materialien – Unterstützung von Marktanalysen und Abstimmung mit Account-Teams – Überwachung von Upselling-, Cross-Selling-Initiativen und Pipeline-Leistung – Verwaltung von Unternehmensreferenzen und Kundenportfolio – Unterstützung des Vertragslebenszyklus (erste Überprüfung, DocuSign, Archivierung) – Sammeln und Konsolidieren von Ressourcen- und Budgeteingaben aus DACH-Konten, Ausschreibungs- und Angebotsmanagement – Unterstützung der Machbarkeitsbewertung und Planung für Ausschreibungen und Mini-Ausschreibungen – Koordinierung interner Stakeholder bei der Angebotserstellung und Angebotspräsentation – Sammeln und Verwalten der erforderlichen Dokumentation – Verwalten von Kundenbeschaffungsportalen (Einreichungen, Fragebögen, Registrierungen) Qualifikationen und technische Fähigkeiten – Abschluss in Informatik, Computertechnik, Cybersicherheit oder einem verwandten Bereich – Vorherige Erfahrung in Informationssicherheit/Cybersicherheit – Gutes Verständnis von IT-Architekturen und Informationssystemen – Erfahrung oder Vertrautheit mit GRC-Aktivitäten – Kenntnisse der wichtigsten Sicherheitsrahmen und -standards (z. B. ISO 27001, NIST, DORA) – Verständnis der Risikomanagement- und Compliance-Grundsätze – Fähigkeit zur Interaktion mit technischen und geschäftlichen Stakeholdern – Gute Englischkenntnisse „Nice to Have“ – Abschluss in Management Engineering, Betriebswirtschaft oder verwandten Bereichen – 2–5 Jahre Erfahrung als PMO oder im Geschäftsbetrieb innerhalb der IT-Beratung – Starke Stakeholder-Management-Fähigkeiten (einschließlich Kontakt auf C-Ebene) – Ausgezeichnete Organisations- und Problemlösungsfähigkeiten – Fähigkeit unabhängig zu arbeiten und mehrere Prioritäten und Interessengruppen zu verwalten – Fortgeschrittene Excel- und PowerPoint-Kenntnisse – Fließende Englisch- und Italienischkenntnisse; Deutsch ist ein Plus. - Previous experience in Information Security / Cybersecurity
- Good understanding of IT architectures and information systems
- Experience or familiarity with GRC activities
- Knowledge of main security frameworks and standards (e.g., ISO 27001, NIST, DORA)
- Understanding of risk management and compliance principles
- Ability to interact with both technical and business stakeholders
- Good command of English

Nice to Have

- Experience in the Financial Services / Banking sector
- Experience with ticketing and workflow management tools
- Security certifications (e.g., ISO 27001, CISM, CISA, Security+)
- Knowledge of vulnerability management or security operations

- This position is fully office-based, requiring a 5-day-per-week on-site commitment
- Candidates should be prepared to relocate to Canton Ticino/Switzerland or towns near the Swiss-Italian border

jobs.description:
#Innovation and Technology #Permanent Position #International Mind-set #Challenging Projects

Fincons Group is an IT business consulting company that has been designing the digital future of leading companies on international markets for 40 years. Fincons Group built its reputation on foreseeing and interpreting new business models and the rapid evolution of IT systems by building a complete range of services: from research and consulting to design and development, from system integration of leading vendor software solutions right up to application management, supporting clients step by step along their digital transformation journey. Fincons is a multinational with over 2,600 people and several offices worldwide (in Italy, Switzerland, Germany, France, the United Kingdom, Belgium and the USA), but above all, a Family Company where the founders play a strategic role with commitment and passion, grounding the company in the same principles of a united and caring family. We firmly believe in the value of cooperation and in the contribution that every idea and intuition can bring. We believe that everyone’s effort can make a difference. Transforming knowledge into a strategic resource is our company mission, and we pursue it with the help of our most strategic asset: our people We are seeking a highly skilled and motivated Senior Test Automation Engineer to ensure the quality, performance, and reliability of our software products. In this hands‑on role role , you will design, develop, and maintain backend automated tests written in Java , with a strong focus on robust API testing. You will also act as a reference point for quality and testing strategy, collaborating closely with developers and stakeholders to integrate testing practices into the development lifecycle and continuously enhance test coverage and efficiency. Key Responsibilities

- Act as fully hands‑on Test Automation for backend and API testing activities
- Design, implement, and maintain Java‑based automated test scripts for backend systems, with a strong emphasis on API testing
- Define and evolve the overall test automation strategy, frameworks, and best practices
- Contribute to test automation coverage of frontend systems when needed
- Translate technical and business requirements into effective and reusable test scenarios
- Execute automated test cases, analyze results, and report defects in a timely and detailed manner
- Investigate and troubleshoot failures and issues during test runs
- Ensure seamless integration of automated tests within CI/CD pipelines
- Coordinate testing activities, prioritize test efforts, and support continuous improvement of testing processes
- Define and implement quality control standards and contribute to continuous improvement initiatives
- Collaborate with the development team to understand application workflows and develop comprehensive test strategies

## Required Qualifications and Skills

- Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or equivalent experience
- 5+ years of hands‑on experience in backend test automation, with a proven track record in API testing
- In-depth experience with tools such as Postman, SoapUI, JMeter
- Strong understanding of RESTful APIs, including test design, automation, validation, and troubleshooting
- Practical experience using SQL for data verification and test setup
- Familiarity with CI/CD tools (e.g., Jenkins, GitHub Actions, etc.)
- Experience with Jira and Xray for test management
- Excellent command of Italian and English (spoken and written)
- ISTQB Certification or similar is a plus
- Hands-on experience with tools such as Tosca Tricentis in a plus
- Solid understanding of Agile methodologies and experience working in Scrum teams
- Strong ownership mindset, proactive attitude, and willingness to actively contribute to day‑to‑day testing activities

## Location Requirement

- Please note that a fully remote work policy is not offered for this role
- Candidates should be prepared to relocate to Canton Ticino/Switzerland or towns near the Swiss-Italian border
- Work-from-home days may be possible according to the Client's policy

Do not hesitate and apply now! Our personnel search is addressed to candidates of all genders.

The data will be processed and stored exclusively for the purposes of this or future selections, in compliance with the Federal Data Protection Law (LPD) and guaranteeing the rights referred to in art. 13 Legislative Decree 196/03 and EU regulation 679/2016 (GDPR)
